query:
SELECT l.task_id, l.purpose AS "purpose: LeasePurpose", l.runner_id, t.team_id
             FROM runner_leases l
             JOIN runners r ON r.id = l.runner_id
             JOIN tasks t ON t.id = l.task_id
            WHERE r.user_id = ?1
              AND (l.expires_at IS NULL OR l.expires_at > ?2)
            ORDER BY l.task_id
